records.name: RPT - Clients Exceeding Debt Threshold
records.query:
SELECT 
    c.name as 'Customer',
    c.customer_name as 'Customer Name',
    COALESCE(c.debt_threshold_amd, 0) as 'Debt Threshold',
    COALESCE(si_sum.total_outstanding, 0) as 'Current Outstanding',
    COALESCE(pe_sum.unallocated_advances, 0) as 'Unallocated Advances',
    (COALESCE(si_sum.total_outstanding, 0) - COALESCE(pe_sum.unallocated_advances, 0)) as 'Net Debt',
    ((COALESCE(si_sum.total_outstanding, 0) - COALESCE(pe_sum.unallocated_advances, 0)) - COALESCE(c.debt_threshold_amd, 0)) as 'Excess Amount'
FROM 	abCustomer c
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        customer,
        SUM(outstanding_amount) as total_outstanding
    FROM 	abSales Invoice
    WHERE docstatus = 1 AND outstanding_amount > 0
    GROUP BY customer
) si_sum ON c.name = si_sum.customer
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        party as customer,
        SUM(unallocated_amount) as unallocated_advances
    FROM 	abPayment Entry
    WHERE docstatus = 1 AND payment_type = 'Receive' AND party_type = 'Customer' AND unallocated_amount > 0
    GROUP BY party
) pe_sum ON c.name = pe_sum.customer
WHERE 
    (COALESCE(si_sum.total_outstanding, 0) - COALESCE(pe_sum.unallocated_advances, 0)) > COALESCE(c.debt_threshold_amd, 0)
ORDER BY ((COALESCE(si_sum.total_outstanding, 0) - COALESCE(pe_sum.unallocated_advances, 0)) - COALESCE(c.debt_threshold_amd, 0)) DESC

records.name: RPT - Collection Set Readiness
records.query:
SELECT 
    cs.name as 'Collection Set',
    cs.item_name as 'Set Name',
    csi.item_code as 'Required Item',
    i.item_name as 'Item Name',
    csi.qty as 'Required Qty',
    COALESCE(sb.actual_qty, 0) as 'Available Qty',
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(sb.actual_qty, 0) >= csi.qty THEN 'Ready'
        WHEN COALESCE(sb.actual_qty, 0) > 0 THEN 'Partial'
        ELSE 'Out of Stock'
    END as 'Status',
    (csi.qty - COALESCE(sb.actual_qty, 0)) as 'Shortage'
FROM 	abItem cs
INNER JOIN 	abCollection Set Item csi ON cs.name = csi.parent
INNER JOIN 	abItem i ON csi.item_code = i.item_code
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        item_code,
        SUM(actual_qty) as actual_qty
    FROM 	abBin
    WHERE warehouse = 'Main - Inmed'
    GROUP BY item_code
) sb ON csi.item_code = sb.item_code
WHERE 
    cs.is_collection_set = 1
    AND cs.disabled = 0
ORDER BY cs.name, 
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(sb.actual_qty, 0) >= csi.qty THEN 1
        WHEN COALESCE(sb.actual_qty, 0) > 0 THEN 2
        ELSE 3
    END,
    csi.item_code

records.name: RPT - Dispatch Case Aging
records.query:
SELECT 
    dc.name as 'Dispatch Case',
    dc.customer as 'Customer',
    dc.status as 'Status',
    dc.creation as 'Created On',
    DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), DATE(dc.creation)) as 'Age (Days)',
    dc.return_expected as 'Return Expected',
    dc.sales_invoice as 'Sales Invoice',
    CASE 
        WHEN dc.status = 'Draft' THEN 'Not submitted yet'
        WHEN dc.status = 'Confirmed' THEN 'Waiting for Pack task'
        WHEN dc.status = 'Packed' THEN 'Waiting for Delivery'
        WHEN dc.status = 'In Transit' THEN 'Delivery in progress'
        WHEN dc.status = 'Awaiting Return Pickup' THEN 'Waiting for return call'
        WHEN dc.status = 'Return Pickup Scheduled' THEN 'Waiting for pickup'
        WHEN dc.status = 'Return In Transit' THEN 'Return pickup in progress'
        WHEN dc.status = 'Returns Received' THEN 'Waiting for returns inspection'
        WHEN dc.status = 'Invoice Pending' THEN 'Waiting for invoice preparation'
        WHEN dc.status = 'Payment Pending' THEN 'Waiting for payment'
        WHEN dc.status = 'Closed' THEN 'Complete'
        ELSE dc.status
    END as 'What is Waiting'
FROM 	abDispatch Case dc
WHERE dc.docstatus = 1 AND dc.status != 'Closed'
ORDER BY DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), DATE(dc.creation)) DESC, dc.status

records.name: RPT - Item - Nomenclature and Prices
records.query:
select
  i.item_code,
  i.item_name,
  i.item_group,
  i.brand,
  i.stock_uom,
  i.has_batch_no,
  i.has_serial_no,
  i.disabled,
  coalesce(selling.price_list_rate, 0) as standard_selling_price,
  coalesce(buying.price_list_rate, 0) as standard_buying_price,
  i.hs_code,
  i.import_tax_rate
from `tabItem` i
left join (
  select item_code, max(price_list_rate) as price_list_rate
  from `tabItem Price`
  where selling = 1 and price_list = 'Standard Selling'
  group by item_code
) selling on selling.item_code = i.name
left join (
  select item_code, max(price_list_rate) as price_list_rate
  from `tabItem Price`
  where buying = 1 and price_list = 'Standard Buying'
  group by item_code
) buying on buying.item_code = i.name
where
  i.disabled = 0
order by i.item_group, i.brand, i.item_name

records.name: RPT - Item - Sort and Classify
records.query:
select
  i.item_code,
  i.item_name,
  i.item_group,
  i.brand,
  i.stock_uom as uom,
  coalesce(total_stock.total_qty, 0) as total_qty,
  coalesce(main_stock.main_warehouse_qty, 0) as main_warehouse_qty,
  coalesce(selling.price_list_rate, 0) as selling_price,
  coalesce(buying.price_list_rate, 0) as buying_price,
  case
    when coalesce(total_stock.total_qty, 0) <= 0 then 'Out of Stock'
    when coalesce(main_stock.main_warehouse_qty, 0) <= 0 then 'Not in Main Warehouse'
    else 'In Stock'
  end as stock_classification
from `tabItem` i
left join (
  select item_code, sum(actual_qty) as total_qty
  from `tabBin`
  group by item_code
) total_stock on total_stock.item_code = i.name
left join (
  select item_code, sum(actual_qty) as main_warehouse_qty
  from `tabBin`
  where warehouse = 'Main - Inmed'
  group by item_code
) main_stock on main_stock.item_code = i.name
left join (
  select item_code, max(price_list_rate) as price_list_rate
  from `tabItem Price`
  where selling = 1 and price_list = 'Standard Selling'
  group by item_code
) selling on selling.item_code = i.name
left join (
  select item_code, max(price_list_rate) as price_list_rate
  from `tabItem Price`
  where buying = 1 and price_list = 'Standard Buying'
  group by item_code
) buying on buying.item_code = i.name
where
  i.disabled = 0
order by
  coalesce(total_stock.total_qty, 0) asc,
  i.item_group asc,
  i.brand asc,
  i.item_code asc

records.name: RPT - Items by Delivery Person
records.query:
SELECT 
    t.owner as 'Delivery Person',
    t.name as 'Task',
    dc.name as 'Dispatch Case',
    dci.item_code as 'Item Code',
    dci.item_name as 'Item Name',
    dci.dispatched_qty as 'Qty',
    CASE 
        WHEN t.task_kind = 'Delivery' AND t.delivery_status IN ('Picked Up', 'Todo') THEN 'Delivery In-Transit - Inmed'
        WHEN t.task_kind = 'Pickup Returns' AND t.pickup_status = 'Picked Up' THEN 'Return Pickup In-Transit - Inmed'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END as 'Current Warehouse',
    t.delivery_status as 'Delivery Status',
    t.pickup_status as 'Pickup Status',
    t.status as 'Task Status'
FROM 	abTask t
INNER JOIN 	abDispatch Case dc ON t.dispatch_case = dc.name
INNER JOIN 	abDispatch Case Item dci ON dc.name = dci.parent
WHERE 
    t.task_kind IN ('Delivery', 'Pickup Returns')
    AND t.status != 'Completed'
    AND (
        (t.task_kind = 'Delivery' AND t.delivery_status IN ('Picked Up', 'Todo'))
        OR (t.task_kind = 'Pickup Returns' AND t.pickup_status = 'Picked Up')
    )
ORDER BY t.owner, dci.item_code

records.name: RPT - Low Stock by Supplier
records.query:
SELECT 
    i.default_supplier as 'Supplier',
    i.item_code as 'Item Code',
    i.item_name as 'Item Name',
    i.item_group as 'Item Group',
    COALESCE(sb.actual_qty, 0) as 'Current Stock',
    COALESCE(i.reorder_level, 0) as 'Reorder Level',
    COALESCE(i.reorder_qty, 0) as 'Reorder Qty',
    (COALESCE(i.reorder_level, 0) - COALESCE(sb.actual_qty, 0)) as 'Shortage',
    i.stock_uom as 'UOM'
FROM 	abItem i
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        item_code,
        SUM(actual_qty) as actual_qty
    FROM 	abBin
    WHERE warehouse = 'Main - Inmed'
    GROUP BY item_code
) sb ON i.item_code = sb.item_code
WHERE 
    i.disabled = 0
    AND i.is_stock_item = 1
    AND COALESCE(sb.actual_qty, 0) < COALESCE(i.reorder_level, 0)
ORDER BY i.default_supplier, (COALESCE(i.reorder_level, 0) - COALESCE(sb.actual_qty, 0)) DESC

records.name: RPT - Prepaid Orders Awaiting Delivery
records.query:
SELECT 
    dc.name as 'Dispatch Case',
    dc.customer as 'Customer',
    dc.status as 'Status',
    dc.creation as 'Created On',
    DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), DATE(dc.creation)) as 'Age (Days)',
    COALESCE(pe_sum.total_advance, 0) as 'Advance Paid',
    COALESCE(si.grand_total, 0) as 'Invoice Amount',
    COALESCE(si.outstanding_amount, 0) as 'Outstanding'
FROM 	abDispatch Case dc
LEFT JOIN 	abSales Invoice si ON dc.sales_invoice = si.name
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        per.reference_name as dispatch_case,
        SUM(per.allocated_amount) as total_advance
    FROM 	abPayment Entry Reference per
    INNER JOIN 	abPayment Entry pe ON per.parent = pe.name
    WHERE pe.docstatus = 1 AND pe.payment_type = 'Receive'
    GROUP BY per.reference_name
) pe_sum ON dc.name = pe_sum.dispatch_case
WHERE 
    dc.docstatus = 1 
    AND dc.status NOT IN ('Closed', 'Cancelled')
    AND COALESCE(pe_sum.total_advance, 0) > 0
ORDER BY DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), DATE(dc.creation)) DESC

records.name: RPT - Price Override List
records.query:
SELECT 
    ip.customer as 'Customer',
    ip.item_code as 'Item Code',
    i.item_name as 'Item Name',
    ip.price_list_rate as 'Special Price',
    spl.price_list_rate as 'Standard Price',
    (ip.price_list_rate - COALESCE(spl.price_list_rate, 0)) as 'Difference',
    ROUND(((ip.price_list_rate - COALESCE(spl.price_list_rate, 0)) / COALESCE(spl.price_list_rate, 1)) * 100, 2) as 'Discount %',
    ip.valid_from as 'Valid From',
    ip.valid_upto as 'Valid Until',
    ip.modified as 'Last Updated'
FROM 	abItem Price ip
INNER JOIN 	abItem i ON ip.item_code = i.item_code
LEFT JOIN 	abItem Price spl ON ip.item_code = spl.item_code 
    AND spl.price_list = 'Standard Selling' 
    AND spl.customer IS NULL
WHERE 
    ip.selling = 1
    AND ip.customer IS NOT NULL
    AND (ip.valid_upto IS NULL OR ip.valid_upto >= CURDATE())
ORDER BY ip.customer, ip.item_code

records.name: RPT - Returns - Refund Queue
records.query:
select
  si.name as credit_note,
  si.customer,
  si.posting_date,
  abs(si.grand_total) as refund_amount,
  abs(si.outstanding_amount) as outstanding_refund_amount,
  si.status,
  si.return_against as original_sales_invoice,
  dc.name as dispatch_case,
  si.remarks
from `tabSales Invoice` si
left join `tabDispatch Case` dc on dc.sales_invoice = si.return_against or dc.sales_invoice = si.name
where
  si.docstatus = 1
  and si.is_return = 1
order by si.posting_date desc, si.name desc

records.name: RPT - Unallocated Customer Advances
records.query:
SELECT 
    pe.party as 'Customer',
    pe.name as 'Payment Entry',
    pe.posting_date as 'Payment Date',
    pe.paid_amount as 'Total Paid',
    pe.unallocated_amount as 'Unallocated Amount',
    pe.mode_of_payment as 'Payment Method',
    pe.reference_no as 'Reference',
    DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), pe.posting_date) as 'Days Since Payment'
FROM 	abPayment Entry pe
WHERE 
    pe.docstatus = 1
    AND pe.payment_type = 'Receive'
    AND pe.party_type = 'Customer'
    AND pe.unallocated_amount > 0
ORDER BY pe.unallocated_amount DESC, pe.posting_date

records.name: RPT — Accounting — Debt Status Board
records.query:
SELECT
  si.customer,
  si.name            AS sales_invoice,
  si.posting_date,
  si.due_date,
  si.grand_total,
  si.outstanding_amount,
  (si.grand_total - si.outstanding_amount) AS paid_amount,
  si.status,
  DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.due_date)          AS overdue_days
FROM `tabSales Invoice` si
WHERE
  si.docstatus = 1
  AND si.grand_total > 0
  AND si.customer = COALESCE(NULLIF(%(customer)s, ''), si.customer)
ORDER BY si.customer, si.due_date ASC

records.name: RPT — Accounting — Income by Period
records.query:
SELECT
  DATE_FORMAT(si.posting_date, '%%Y-%%m')      AS period,
  COUNT(DISTINCT si.name)                      AS invoice_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT si.customer)                  AS customer_count,
  SUM(sii.amount)                              AS net_sales,
  SUM(si.grand_total)                          AS gross_sales,
  SUM(si.grand_total - si.outstanding_amount)  AS collected_amount
FROM `tabSales Invoice` si
JOIN `tabSales Invoice Item` sii ON sii.parent = si.name
WHERE
  si.docstatus = 1
  AND si.customer = COALESCE(NULLIF(%(customer)s, ''), si.customer)
  AND sii.item_group = COALESCE(NULLIF(%(item_group)s, ''), sii.item_group)
GROUP BY period
ORDER BY period

records.name: RPT — Accounting — Sales Documents and Payments
records.report_name: RPT — Accounting — Sales Documents and Payments
records.query:
SELECT
  si.posting_date,
  si.name            AS sales_invoice,
  si.customer,
  si.grand_total,
  si.outstanding_amount,
  si.status          AS payment_status,
  pe.name            AS payment_entry,
  pe.posting_date    AS payment_date,
  per.allocated_amount,
  pe.reference_no    AS bank_ref
FROM `tabSales Invoice` si
LEFT JOIN `tabPayment Entry Reference` per
  ON per.reference_doctype = 'Sales Invoice'
  AND per.reference_name = si.name
LEFT JOIN `tabPayment Entry` pe
  ON pe.name = per.parent
  AND pe.docstatus = 1
WHERE
  si.docstatus = 1
  AND si.customer = COALESCE(NULLIF(%(customer)s, ''), si.customer)
ORDER BY si.posting_date DESC, si.name DESC

records.name: RPT — Ops — Driver Task Queue (Derived)
records.query:
SELECT
  JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(t._assign, '$[0]')) AS assigned_to,
  t.name AS task,
  t.task_kind,
  t.status,
  t.customer,
  t.surgery_case,
  t.sales_order,
  t.sales_invoice,
  t.dispatch_group_id,
  t.subject,
  t.modified
FROM `tabTask` t
WHERE
  t.status NOT IN ('Completed', 'Cancelled')
  AND t.task_kind IN ('Delivery', 'Pickup Returns', 'Return drop-off at warehouse')
  AND (
    %(assigned_to)s IS NULL
    OR %(assigned_to)s = ''
    OR t._assign LIKE CONCAT('%', %(assigned_to)s, '%')
  )
ORDER BY assigned_to, t.modified ASC

records.name: RPT — Ops — Prepaid Orders Awaiting Delivery
records.report_name: RPT — Ops — Prepaid Orders Awaiting Delivery
records.query:
select
  so.customer,
  so.name as sales_order,
  so.transaction_date,
  so.delivery_date,
  so.grand_total,
  so.per_delivered,
  coalesce(sum(case when pe.name is not null then per.allocated_amount else 0 end), 0) as advance_allocated
from 	abSales Order so
left join 	abPayment Entry Reference per
  on per.reference_doctype = 'Sales Order'
  and per.reference_name = so.name
left join 	abPayment Entry pe
  on pe.name = per.parent
  and pe.docstatus = 1
  and pe.party_type = 'Customer'
  and pe.payment_type = 'Receive'
where
  so.docstatus = 1
  and so.status not in ('Closed', 'Completed')
  and so.per_delivered < 100
  and (%(customer)s is null or %(customer)s = '' or so.customer = %(customer)s)
group by so.name
having advance_allocated > 0
order by so.delivery_date asc, so.transaction_date asc

records.name: RPT — Purchasing — Norm and Reorder
records.query:
select
  i.item_code,
  i.item_name,
  i.item_group,
  ir.warehouse,
  ir.warehouse_reorder_level as reorder_level,
  ir.warehouse_reorder_qty as reorder_qty,
  coalesce(b.actual_qty, 0) as current_stock,
  round(coalesce(u.avg_daily_qty, 0), 3) as avg_daily_usage,
  round(coalesce(u.avg_daily_qty, 0) * 30 * 1.20, 1) as norm_30d,
  round(coalesce(u.avg_daily_qty, 0) * 60 * 1.20, 1) as norm_60d,
  case
    when coalesce(b.actual_qty, 0) <= coalesce(ir.warehouse_reorder_level, 0)
      then 'Below Reorder Level'
    when coalesce(b.actual_qty, 0) < coalesce(u.avg_daily_qty, 0) * 30 * 1.20
      then 'Below 30d Norm'
    else 'OK'
  end as reorder_status
from `tabItem` i
join `tabItem Reorder` ir on ir.parent = i.name
left join `tabBin` b
  on b.item_code = i.name and b.warehouse = ir.warehouse
left join (
  select
    item_code,
    warehouse,
    abs(sum(actual_qty)) / greatest(datediff(curdate(), min(posting_date)), 1) as avg_daily_qty
  from `tabStock Ledger Entry`
  where
    is_cancelled = 0
    and actual_qty < 0
    and posting_date >= date_sub(curdate(), interval %(analysis_days)s day)
  group by item_code, warehouse
) u on u.item_code = i.name and u.warehouse = ir.warehouse
where
  i.disabled = 0
order by reorder_status desc, i.item_group, i.item_code

records.name: RPT — Purchasing — Supplier Performance
records.query:
SELECT
  po.supplier,
  po.name                                         AS purchase_order,
  po.transaction_date                             AS order_date,
  po.delivery_date                                AS expected_date,
  po.grand_total                                  AS order_value,
  po.per_received                                 AS received_pct,
  MIN(pr.posting_date)                            AS first_receipt_date,
  DATEDIFF(MIN(pr.posting_date), po.delivery_date) AS delay_days
FROM `tabPurchase Order` po
LEFT JOIN `tabPurchase Receipt Item` pri ON pri.purchase_order = po.name
LEFT JOIN `tabPurchase Receipt` pr ON pr.name = pri.parent AND pr.docstatus = 1
WHERE
  po.docstatus = 1
  AND po.supplier = COALESCE(NULLIF(%(supplier)s, ''), po.supplier)
GROUP BY po.name
ORDER BY po.transaction_date DESC

records.name: RPT — Receivables — Unallocated Advances
records.query:
SELECT
  pe.party AS customer,
  pe.name AS payment_entry,
  pe.posting_date,
  pe.paid_amount,
  COALESCE(SUM(per.allocated_amount), 0) AS allocated_amount,
  (pe.paid_amount - COALESCE(SUM(per.allocated_amount), 0)) AS unallocated_amount
FROM `tabPayment Entry` pe
LEFT JOIN `tabPayment Entry Reference` per
  ON per.parent = pe.name
  AND per.reference_doctype = 'Sales Invoice'
WHERE
  pe.docstatus = 1
  AND pe.party_type = 'Customer'
  AND pe.payment_type = 'Receive'
  AND pe.party = COALESCE(NULLIF(%(customer)s, ''), pe.party)
GROUP BY pe.name
HAVING unallocated_amount > 0.0001
ORDER BY pe.party, pe.posting_date DESC

records.name: RPT — Receivables — Unpaid Invoices (Aging)
records.query:
SELECT
  si.customer,
  si.name AS sales_invoice,
  si.posting_date,
  si.due_date,
  si.status,
  si.outstanding_amount,
  DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.posting_date) AS age_days,
  DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.due_date) AS overdue_days
FROM `tabSales Invoice` si
WHERE
  si.docstatus = 1
  AND si.outstanding_amount > 0
  AND si.customer = COALESCE(NULLIF(%(customer)s, ''), si.customer)
  AND (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR si.posting_date >= %(from_date)s)
  AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR si.posting_date <= %(to_date)s)
ORDER BY si.customer, overdue_days DESC, age_days DESC

records.name: RPT — Risk — Debt Threshold Exceeded
records.query:
SELECT
  c.name AS customer,
  c.customer_name,
  c.debt_threshold_amd,
  COALESCE(gl.net_receivable_amd, 0) AS net_receivable_amd,
  (COALESCE(gl.net_receivable_amd, 0) - COALESCE(c.debt_threshold_amd, 0)) AS exceeded_by_amd
FROM `tabCustomer` c
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    party AS customer,
    SUM(debit - credit) AS net_receivable_amd
  FROM `tabGL Entry`
  WHERE
    is_cancelled = 0
    AND party_type = 'Customer'
  GROUP BY party
) gl ON gl.customer = c.name
WHERE
  c.disabled = 0
  AND COALESCE(c.debt_threshold_amd, 0) > 0
  AND COALESCE(gl.net_receivable_amd, 0) > COALESCE(c.debt_threshold_amd, 0)
ORDER BY exceeded_by_amd DESC

records.name: RPT — Sales — Comparative Periods
records.query:
SELECT
  sii.item_code,
  i.item_name,
  i.item_group,
  SUM(sii.qty) AS total_qty,
  SUM(sii.amount) AS total_amount
FROM `tabSales Invoice` si
JOIN `tabSales Invoice Item` sii ON sii.parent = si.name
JOIN `tabItem` i ON i.name = sii.item_code
WHERE
  si.docstatus = 1
  AND sii.item_group = COALESCE(NULLIF(%(item_group)s, ''), sii.item_group)
  AND si.customer = COALESCE(NULLIF(%(customer)s, ''), si.customer)
GROUP BY sii.item_code
ORDER BY total_amount DESC

records.name: RPT — Sales — History by Client
records.query:
SELECT
  si.customer,
  si.hospital,
  si.hospital_branch,
  si.doctor_name,
  si.name AS sales_invoice,
  si.posting_date,
  sii.item_code,
  sii.item_name,
  sii.qty,
  sii.rate,
  sii.amount
FROM `tabSales Invoice` si
JOIN `tabSales Invoice Item` sii ON sii.parent = si.name
WHERE
  si.docstatus = 1
  AND si.customer = COALESCE(NULLIF(%(customer)s, ''), si.customer)
  AND (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR %(from_date)s = '' OR si.posting_date >= %(from_date)s)
  AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR %(to_date)s = '' OR si.posting_date <= %(to_date)s)

records.name: RPT — Sales — Sold Items Detail
records.query:
SELECT
  si.posting_date,
  si.name              AS sales_invoice,
  si.customer,
  si.hospital,
  si.hospital_branch,
  si.doctor_name,
  si.status            AS payment_status,
  sii.item_code,
  sii.item_name,
  sii.item_group,
  sii.qty,
  sii.uom,
  sii.rate             AS selling_price,
  sii.amount           AS selling_amount,
  COALESCE(bp.price_list_rate, 0)                                    AS buying_price,
  sii.qty * COALESCE(bp.price_list_rate, 0)                          AS buying_amount,
  sii.amount - sii.qty * COALESCE(bp.price_list_rate, 0)              AS gross_profit,
  sii.batch_no,
  sii.serial_no,
  si.sales_order
FROM `tabSales Invoice` si
JOIN `tabSales Invoice Item` sii ON sii.parent = si.name
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT item_code, MAX(price_list_rate) AS price_list_rate
  FROM `tabItem Price`
  WHERE price_list = 'Standard Buying' AND buying = 1
  GROUP BY item_code
) bp ON bp.item_code = sii.item_code
WHERE
  si.docstatus = 1
  AND si.customer = COALESCE(NULLIF(%(customer)s, ''), si.customer)
  AND sii.item_code = COALESCE(NULLIF(%(item_code)s, ''), sii.item_code)
  AND sii.item_group = COALESCE(NULLIF(%(item_group)s, ''), sii.item_group)
ORDER BY si.posting_date DESC, si.name DESC

records.name: RPT — Sales — Top Customers
records.query:
SELECT
  si.customer,
  c.customer_group,
  COUNT(DISTINCT si.name) AS invoice_count,
  SUM(sii.qty)            AS total_qty,
  SUM(sii.amount)         AS total_amount
FROM `tabSales Invoice` si
JOIN `tabSales Invoice Item` sii ON sii.parent = si.name
JOIN `tabCustomer` c ON c.name = si.customer
WHERE
  si.docstatus = 1
  AND sii.item_group = COALESCE(NULLIF(%(item_group)s, ''), sii.item_group)
  AND c.customer_group = COALESCE(NULLIF(%(customer_group)s, ''), c.customer_group)
GROUP BY si.customer
ORDER BY total_amount DESC
LIMIT 100

records.query:
SELECT
  b.warehouse,
  b.item_code,

  i.item_group,
  i.brand,
  b.actual_qty,
  b.reserved_qty,
  b.ordered_qty,

records.name: RPT — Stock — Batch and Expiry Balance
records.report_name: RPT — Stock — Batch and Expiry Balance
records.query:
SELECT
  sle.warehouse,
  sle.item_code,
  i.item_name,
  i.item_group,
  sle.batch_no,
  ba.expiry_date,
  CASE
    WHEN ba.expiry_date IS NULL THEN 'No Expiry'
    WHEN ba.expiry_date < CURDATE() THEN 'Expired'
    WHEN ba.expiry_date <= DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) THEN 'Near Expiry'
    ELSE 'Valid'
  END AS expiry_status,
  DATEDIFF(ba.expiry_date, CURDATE()) AS days_to_expiry,
  SUM(sle.actual_qty) AS qty
FROM `tabStock Ledger Entry` sle
JOIN `tabItem` i ON i.name = sle.item_code
LEFT JOIN `tabBatch` ba ON ba.name = sle.batch_no
WHERE
  sle.is_cancelled = 0
  AND sle.batch_no IS NOT NULL
  AND sle.batch_no != ''
  AND sle.warehouse = COALESCE(NULLIF(%(warehouse)s, ''), sle.warehouse)
  AND sle.item_code = COALESCE(NULLIF(%(item_code)s, ''), sle.item_code)
  AND i.item_group = COALESCE(NULLIF(%(item_group)s, ''), i.item_group)
GROUP BY sle.warehouse, sle.item_code, sle.batch_no
HAVING qty > 0
ORDER BY ba.expiry_date ASC, sle.warehouse, sle.item_code

records.name: RPT — Stock — Entries by Period
records.query:
SELECT
  se.posting_date,
  se.name             AS stock_entry,
  se.purpose          AS entry_type,
  sed.s_warehouse,
  sed.t_warehouse,
  sed.item_code,
  i.item_name,
  i.item_group,
  sed.qty,
  sed.batch_no,
  sed.serial_no,
  se.sales_order,
  se.dispatch_group_id,

FROM `tabStock Entry` se

WHERE
  se.docstatus = 1
  AND sed.s_warehouse = COALESCE(NULLIF(%(warehouse)s, ''), sed.s_warehouse)
  AND sed.item_code = COALESCE(NULLIF(%(item_code)s, ''), sed.item_code)
  AND i.item_group = COALESCE(NULLIF(%(item_group)s, ''), i.item_group)
  AND se.purpose = COALESCE(NULLIF(%(purpose)s, ''), se.purpose)
ORDER BY se.posting_date DESC, se.name DESC

records.name: RPT — Stock — Expiry Classification
records.query:
SELECT
  i.item_code,
  i.item_name,
  i.item_group,
  i.brand,
  CASE WHEN i.has_expiry_date = 1 THEN 'Expirable' ELSE 'Non-Expirable' END AS expiry_tracking,
  CASE WHEN i.has_batch_no = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS batch_tracking,
  COALESCE(stock.qty, 0) AS stock_qty
FROM `tabItem` i
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT item_code, SUM(actual_qty) AS qty
  FROM `tabBin`
  WHERE actual_qty > 0
  GROUP BY item_code
) stock ON stock.item_code = i.name
WHERE
  i.disabled = 0
  AND i.is_stock_item = 1
  AND COALESCE(stock.qty, 0) > 0
  AND i.item_group = COALESCE(NULLIF(%(item_group)s, ''), i.item_group)
  AND (
    %(expiry_tracking)s IS NULL OR %(expiry_tracking)s = ''
    OR (%(expiry_tracking)s = 'Expirable' AND i.has_expiry_date = 1)
    OR (%(expiry_tracking)s = 'Non-Expirable' AND i.has_expiry_date = 0)
  )
ORDER BY i.item_group, i.has_expiry_date DESC, i.item_code

records.name: RPT — Stock — In-Transit Stuck (Age Check)
records.query:
SELECT
  b.warehouse,
  b.item_code,
  i.item_name,
  b.actual_qty,
  x.last_movement_date,
  DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), x.last_movement_date) AS days_since_last_movement
FROM `tabBin` b
JOIN `tabItem` i ON i.name = b.item_code
JOIN (
  SELECT
    warehouse,
    item_code,
    MAX(posting_date) AS last_movement_date
  FROM `tabStock Ledger Entry`
  WHERE
    is_cancelled = 0
    AND warehouse IN ('Delivery In-Transit - Inmed', 'Return Pickup In-Transit - Inmed')
  GROUP BY warehouse, item_code
) x ON x.warehouse = b.warehouse AND x.item_code = b.item_code
WHERE
  b.warehouse IN ('Delivery In-Transit - Inmed', 'Return Pickup In-Transit - Inmed')
  AND b.actual_qty > 0
  AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), x.last_movement_date) >= %(min_days)s
ORDER BY days_since_last_movement DESC, b.warehouse, b.item_code

records.name: RPT — Stock — Near Expiry (Main - Inmed)
records.query:
SELECT
  sle.item_code,
  i.item_name,
  sle.batch_no,
  b.expiry_date,
  SUM(sle.actual_qty) AS qty_in_main_wh,
  DATEDIFF(b.expiry_date, CURDATE()) AS days_to_expiry
FROM `tabStock Ledger Entry` sle
JOIN `tabBatch` b ON b.name = sle.batch_no
JOIN `tabItem` i ON i.name = sle.item_code
WHERE
  sle.is_cancelled = 0
  AND sle.warehouse = 'Main - Inmed'
  AND sle.batch_no IS NOT NULL
  AND sle.batch_no != ''
  AND b.expiry_date IS NOT NULL
  AND b.expiry_date <= DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL %(near_expiry_days)s DAY)
GROUP BY sle.item_code, sle.batch_no
HAVING qty_in_main_wh > 0
ORDER BY b.expiry_date ASC, sle.item_code

records.name: RPT — Stock — Near Expiry Value at Risk
records.report_name: RPT — Stock — Near Expiry Value at Risk
records.query:
SELECT
  sle.warehouse,
  sle.item_code,
  i.item_name,
  i.item_group,
  sle.batch_no,
  ba.expiry_date,
  DATEDIFF(ba.expiry_date, CURDATE())                             AS days_to_expiry,
  SUM(sle.actual_qty)                                             AS qty,
  COALESCE(bp.price_list_rate, 0)                                 AS buying_price,
  SUM(sle.actual_qty) * COALESCE(bp.price_list_rate, 0)           AS value_at_risk
FROM `tabStock Ledger Entry` sle
JOIN `tabBatch` ba ON ba.name = sle.batch_no
JOIN `tabItem` i ON i.name = sle.item_code
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT item_code, MAX(price_list_rate) AS price_list_rate
  FROM `tabItem Price`
  WHERE price_list = 'Standard Buying' AND buying = 1
  GROUP BY item_code
) bp ON bp.item_code = sle.item_code
WHERE
  sle.is_cancelled = 0
  AND sle.batch_no IS NOT NULL AND sle.batch_no != ''
  AND ba.expiry_date IS NOT NULL
  AND ba.expiry_date <= DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL COALESCE(NULLIF(%(near_expiry_days)s, ''), 0) DAY)
  AND sle.warehouse = COALESCE(NULLIF(%(warehouse)s, ''), sle.warehouse)
  AND i.item_group = COALESCE(NULLIF(%(item_group)s, ''), i.item_group)
GROUP BY sle.warehouse, sle.item_code, sle.batch_no
HAVING SUM(sle.actual_qty) > 0
ORDER BY ba.expiry_date ASC, sle.warehouse, sle.item_code

records.name: RPT — Stock — Slow-Moving Products
records.query:
SELECT
  i.item_code,
  i.item_name,
  i.item_group,
  i.brand,
  COALESCE(stock.qty, 0)  AS current_stock,
  sales.last_sale_date,
  DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), COALESCE(sales.last_sale_date, DATE(i.creation))) AS days_since_last_sale
FROM `tabItem` i
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT item_code, SUM(actual_qty) AS qty
  FROM `tabBin`
  WHERE actual_qty > 0
  GROUP BY item_code
) stock ON stock.item_code = i.name
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT item_code, MAX(posting_date) AS last_sale_date
  FROM `tabStock Ledger Entry`
  WHERE
    is_cancelled = 0
    AND actual_qty < 0
    AND voucher_type IN ('Sales Invoice', 'Delivery Note')
  GROUP BY item_code
) sales ON sales.item_code = i.name
WHERE
  i.disabled = 0
  AND i.is_stock_item = 1
  AND COALESCE(stock.qty, 0) > 0
  AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), COALESCE(sales.last_sale_date, DATE(i.creation))) >= COALESCE(NULLIF(%(min_days)s, ''), 0)
  AND i.item_group = COALESCE(NULLIF(%(item_group)s, ''), i.item_group)
ORDER BY days_since_last_sale DESC

records.name: RPT — Stock — Warehouse Movement
records.query:
SELECT
  se.posting_date,
  se.name              AS stock_entry,
  se.purpose           AS movement_type,
  sed.s_warehouse,
  sed.t_warehouse,
  sed.item_code,
  i.item_name,
  i.item_group,
  sed.qty,
  sed.batch_no,
  sed.serial_no,
  se.sales_order,
  se.dispatch_group_id,
  se.remarks
FROM `tabStock Entry` se
JOIN `tabStock Entry Detail` sed ON sed.parent = se.name
JOIN `tabItem` i ON i.name = sed.item_code
WHERE
  se.docstatus = 1
  AND sed.s_warehouse IS NOT NULL AND sed.s_warehouse != ''
  AND sed.t_warehouse IS NOT NULL AND sed.t_warehouse != ''
  AND sed.s_warehouse = COALESCE(NULLIF(%(s_warehouse)s, ''), sed.s_warehouse)
  AND sed.t_warehouse = COALESCE(NULLIF(%(t_warehouse)s, ''), sed.t_warehouse)
  AND sed.item_code = COALESCE(NULLIF(%(item_code)s, ''), sed.item_code)
  AND se.dispatch_group_id = COALESCE(NULLIF(%(dispatch_group_id)s, ''), se.dispatch_group_id)
ORDER BY se.posting_date DESC, se.name DESC

records.name: RPT — Surgery Cases — Aging (Open)
records.query:
SELECT
  sc.name                                AS surgery_case,
  sc.workflow_state,
  sc.client,
  sc.hospital,
  sc.hospital_branch,
  sc.surgery_date,
  sc.delivery_person,
  sc.return_pickup_delivery_person,
  sc.modified,
  DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), DATE(sc.modified)) AS age_days
FROM `tabSurgery Case` sc
WHERE
  sc.workflow_state NOT IN ('Closed')
ORDER BY age_days DESC, sc.modified ASC
